title: Term 1 and 2 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 1 and 2.
This question paper consists of 5 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.
Show your working, and round your answers as each question asks.

sections.title: QUESTION 1: Numbers and Calculations in Context

questions.prompt: A school must transport 230 learners. Each bus holds 65 learners. How many buses are needed?
Calculate 12% of R850.
The price of bread rose from R16 to R18. Calculate the percentage increase.
A car travels 270 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
Which is better value: 750 ml of juice for R18,99 or 2 ℓ for R45,99? Show your working.
questions.memo:
✓ 750 ml: R18,99 ÷ 0,75 = R25,32 per litre (1)
✓ 2 ℓ: R45,99 ÷ 2 = R23,00 per litre (1)
✓ 2 ℓ is better value (1)

questions.prompt: A bakkie uses 9 ℓ per 100 km. Diesel costs R22,80 per litre. Calculate the fuel cost of a 250 km journey.
A plumber charges $C = 350 + 200h$ (rand), where $h$ is hours worked. What is the cost of a 3-hour job?
Using $C = 350 + 200h$, how many hours were worked if the bill was R1 550?
Which is an example of direct proportion?
options: Speed and travel time for a fixed distance
Number of tickets bought and total cost
Number of people sharing a pizza and slices each
Workers and days to finish a job

questions.prompt: The graph of a direct proportion always passes through the origin.
Describe the shape of the graph of an inverse proportion.
questions.memo:
✓ A curve, not a straight line (1)
✓ that gets closer to the axes but never touches them (1)

questions.prompt: In $C = 50 + 12d$, what do the numbers 50 and 12 represent?
questions.memo:
✓ R50 is the fixed (starting) fee (1)
✓ R12 is the cost per kilometre (1)

sections.title: QUESTION 3: Finance: Income, Expenditure and Budgets

questions.prompt: Take-home pay after deductions is called…
Calculate the employee's UIF contribution on a gross salary of R12 400.
Which is a fixed expense?
Gross pay is R8 600 and total deductions are R1 340. Calculate net pay.
If expenditure is greater than income, the budget has a deficit.
Classify each item.
A security guard earns R65 per hour for 40 hours a week, and overtime at 1,5 times the normal rate. Calculate his gross pay for a week in which he works 46 hours.
A family spends R3 150 on groceries out of a net income of R18 000. What percentage of income is this?

sections.title: QUESTION 4: Finance: Financial Documents and Tariffs

questions.prompt: What is the VAT rate in South Africa?
Which item is zero-rated for VAT?
On a bank statement, a debit is money paid out of the account.
Match each document to its purpose.

pairs.right: Requests payment for goods or services
Record of money in and out of an account

questions.prompt: An account has a balance of R2 340. A salary of R9 500 is paid in, and debit orders of R3 200 and R1 150 go off, plus R65 bank charges. What is the new balance?
Nomsa saves R2 500 at 7% simple interest per year. How much will she have after 2 years?
For the same amount, rate and time, compound interest gives a bigger total than simple interest (for more than one year).
Match each banking term to its meaning.

pairs.right: Money taken out of an account
Amount in the account at a given time
Spending more than you have, at a cost

questions.prompt: Pieter draws R200 cash from an ATM eight times a month and pays R11,50 each time. Calculate his ATM fees and suggest TWO ways he could pay less.
questions.memo:
✓ 8 × R11,50 = R92,00 (2)
✓ e.g. draw cash less often in bigger amounts (1)
✓ e.g. swipe his card or pay with an app instead of using cash; use his own bank's ATM; get cash back at a till (1)
